neighbours.label: Fires at the end of a fronted viewpoint adverbial that says from which angle the rest is judged (Visually, | To collectors, | Environmentally, | Design-wise, | To the naked eye,), not at the end of fronted time or contrast adverbials.
fire: The bridge took ten years to build. Structurally, it is a marvel of steel.
Most tourists walk past the stone. To geologists, it tells the whole story of the valley.
The phone is cheap. Performance-wise, it beats many flagship models.
The soup looked simple. To an expert palate, it had a dozen layers of flavour.
The town is small. Economically, it depends on a single factory.
The film was a box-office flop. Artistically, it was years ahead of its time.
The paint looks dry. To the untrained eye, the two colours are identical.
The law sounds harmless. Legally, it gives the police enormous power.
quiet: The bridge took ten years to build. Finally, it opened in the spring of 1932.
Most tourists walk past the stone. On Sundays, the square is full of markets.
The phone is cheap. Last month, it sold out in two days.
The soup looked simple. Nevertheless, we ordered a second bowl.
The town is small. In winter, it is often cut off by snow.
The film was a box-office flop. Two years later, it was released on video.
The paint looks dry. Even so, wait another hour before touching it.
The law sounds harmless. In 2019, it was passed without debate.

predictions: Fire 0.45-0.8, median ~0.6. Time/contrast/place near misses <= 0.07. AUROC ~1.
short: end of a fronted viewpoint adverbial
notes: Probes: 'To collectors,' 0.78; 'To the naked eye,' 0.70 (' eye'); 'Environmentally,' 0.57; 'Visually,' 0.55; 'Design-wise,' 0.48 ('-wise'); matched near misses 'Yesterday,' 0.06, 'After dinner,' 0.04, 'However,' 0.01. The - pole peaks on sentence-initial ' Also'. Each fire item has a lead-in sentence so the adverbial is mid-document.
